'''Rul Jophen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was assigned to negotiate with the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] regarding a potential alliance with the Empire.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rul Jophen appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss.
